name: sparrow
description: AI fitness coach — connects Strava, plans weekly workouts, sends daily Telegram reminders

scripts.deploy: node scripts/test-suite.mjs --full --debug && url=$(vercel deploy --prod | grep -o 'https://sparrow-[a-z0-9]*-aibuilder\.vercel\.app' | head -1) && echo "Deployed: $url" && vercel alias set $url talktosparrow.vercel.app && node scripts/smoke-test.mjs
